title: Union bound for large decision-tree depth under a random restriction
statement:
Let $D_0,\dots,D_{s-1}$ be $s$ DNF formulas on $n$ Boolean variables, with $n \ge 1$, each of width at most $w$ where $w \ge 1$, and suppose that in every term of every $D_i$ each variable occurs at most once (no term repeats a literal, and any two literals of a term on the same variable coincide). Let $p \in \bbr$ satisfy $0 < p \le \tfrac{1}{40w}$ and $p \le 1$. Draw a Bernoulli$(p)$ random restriction $\rho$, which independently leaves each variable free with probability $p$ and otherwise fixes it to $\mathtt{false}$ or $\mathtt{true}$ each with probability $(1-p)/2$. Then the probability that some restricted formula $D_i\!\restriction_\rho$ computes a Boolean function of decision-tree depth greater than $l$ is at most
\[
  s\left(\left(\tfrac12\right)^{l} + \exp\!\left(-\tfrac{np}{3}\right)\right).
\]
hypotheses_covered: family of s DNF formulas gates_i on n variables
each DNF has width at most w
within each term, literals sharing a variable are equal
each term has no duplicate literals
replaced:
Let $\mathrm{gates}_0,\dots,\mathrm{gates}_{s-1}$ be $s$ many $\mathrm{DNF}$s, each of width at
most $w>0$ (with distinct variables per term and no duplicate literals), let $n>0$, and let
$0<p\le \tfrac{1}{40w}$ with $p\le 1$. Then the probability under a Bernoulli$(p)$ restriction
$\rho$ that some gate $\mathrm{gates}_i$ has $\mathrm{dtDepth}(\mathrm{gates}_i|_\rho) > l$ is
at most
\[
  s\cdot\Bigl(\Bigl(\tfrac12\Bigr)^l + \exp\!\Bigl(-\tfrac{np}{3}\Bigr)\Bigr).
\]
